text:
Maya: Uploading the penetration test + vuln-scan bundle for NovoHealth to s3://redwood-cust-evidence/novohealth/2024-04-05/
Maya: Included: pen-test-report.pdf, external-scan.json, internal-scan.json, asset-inventory.csv, egress-ips.txt, checksums.txt
Maya: Asking security/legal to validate and produce an evidence summary we can hand to the customer. Customer wants remediation timeline and patch owners by EOD Tuesday. @Carlos @Zoe

Carlos: Got the S3 link, grabbing now. Quick note — pen-test PDF currently unsigned and missing the scope appendix. I'll run a cursory vuln parse and surface critical/high items.
Carlos: Running local command: ```jq '.vulnerabilities | map(select(.severity=="critical" or .severity=="high"))' external-scan.json | wc -l``` — will report counts in a few.

Deploy Bot: vuln-scan-summary: critical=3, high=12, medium=21, low=47. Artifacts verified: checksums match.

Priya: Two quick customer asks that drive scope of evidence:
- Can we redact internal hostnames/IPs in the public bundle? Customer prefers redaction for display to non-security folks.
- They need the egress IPs (for allowlist) as a separate signed file.

Zoe: Redaction OK for public-facing summary but legal needs an unredacted copy retained and an attestation that we validated scope and signatures. We need an authorization letter from the pen-test vendor confirming they had permission to test the customer's assets. Also confirm retention period (customer asked 90 days).

Carlos: Parsed external-scan.json: critical=3 (CVE-2023-XXXX on nginx, high-severity auth bypass on vendor component, exposed Redis), high=12. I'll create a triage spreadsheet and assign severity owners.
Carlos: Proposed owners:
- Arjun (infra): exposed Redis + egress hardening
- DevOps Team (via Arjun): nginx CVE patch + config change
- App Security (me): vendor component auth bypass reproducibility + mitigations

Arjun: I can own infra items. ETA for initial mitigation plan: tomorrow EOD. For nginx CVE we can patch in canary within 48 hours and full rollout in 5 days (pending canary results). Will attach change plan.

Maya: Thanks. I'll update the customer-facing bundle: redact hostnames in public_summary.zip, create signed_egress_ips.txt with deploy signature, and upload the unredacted bundle to restricted S3 path for legal.
Maya: New artifact paths:
- s3://redwood-cust-evidence/novohealth/2024-04-05/public_summary.zip
- s3://redwood-cust-evidence/novohealth/2024-04-05/unredacted_bundle_priv/ (access: legal & security)
- s3://redwood-cust-evidence/novohealth/2024-04-05/signed_egress_ips.txt

Zoe: I'll prepare the attestation template and request vendor signature. Also confirm retention: we agree to 90 days unless customer requests otherwise. Add this to the evidence package.

Carlos: I've started the triage sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example - columns: finding id, severity, owner, remediation ETA, customer impact, notes. Filling high/critical rows now.

Priya: Customer-facing timeline to propose:
- Today: deliver public_summary + signed egress IPs + remediation owner names
- Tue EOD: remediation plan for high/critical with dates (canary + full rollout)
- 2 weeks: verification report for high/critical mitigations

Maya: I'll send the package to the customer's security contact after we have the signed egress file and Zoe's attestation. FYI sales: pricing/legal blocker flagged: customer wants proof of pen-test scope to sign off before payment milestone. Zoe, can we expedite vendor attestation?

Zoe: I'll ping the vendor legal contact right after this thread. Expect initial attestation draft in 4 hours.

Arjun: For tracking — I'll add my remediation tasks to the triage sheet and link PRs/CLs as they land. Risk mitigation plan: canary deploy -> monitor KV cache behavior -> rollback criteria enumerated.

Maya: Action items summary (assignments):
- Carlos: finish triage sheet + top-3 mitigations doc (due tomorrow noon)
- Arjun: infra remediation plan + canary schedule (due tomorrow EOD)
- Zoe: vendor attestation + retention confirmation (due in 4 hours)
- Maya: prepare public bundle + signed egress file (due today EOD)
- Priya: coordinate customer expectation and confirm payment milestone dependency (sync today 3pm)

Priya: I can host 3pm sync with customer, Carlos + Arjun optional. Will share calendar invite.

Carlos: Acknowledged. I'll have the triage populated by noon.

Maya: Great — thanks everyone. Once attestation is in we can push the public bundle to the customer and close the presales blocker.

Priya: 👍
Zoe: ✅
Arjun: 👌
Deploy Bot: checksum verification: checksums.txt matches artifacts (sha256 OK)
